newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs mostly steady, topside weighted by Nikkei.
newsitem.headline: JGBs mostly steady, topside weighted by Nikkei.

text.p: Japanese government bonds (JGBs) were mostly steady but suffering from a downward bias in Tuesday morning trade, the topside weighted by a recovery in Tokyo stocks.
The key Nikkei-225 index stood at 19,231.82 at 0038 GMT, up 190.72 from Monday's close, and traders said this was exerting slight downward pressure on bonds.

The key September's failure in recent days to achieve a sustained rise above 127 was also leading to some sales, a city bank trader said. Key September was at 126.93, down 0.02 from Monday's close, in thin trade.
Although the market had been watching for movements by investors, who have recently been sidelined due to summer vacations, no such activity was detected.

Some traders had earlier said investors were more likely to sell bonds. But a securities firm trader said that as investors do not seem to currently have large bond holdings, buying is more likely than selling once they do return to the market.
The yield on the benchmark 182nd 10-year cash bond was at 2.085 percent, unchanged from Monday's close.
